summary: OraSure Technologies filed an 8-K announcing FDA clearance of its Colli-Pee Dx Urine Collection Kit for at-home self-collection of first-void urine, to be used with Roche molecular tests for four sexually transmitted infections on Roche's cobas systems. This is a routine product regulatory milestone, not a special situation. No deal terms, board actions, or strategic changes are involved. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special-situations event.
